_comment: The single truth table for derived task status. Both implementations read
THIS file: lib/live-status.sh (shell consumers) and hub.py (the web view).
It exists because the bug being fixed is 'two models of the same fact drift
apart', and writing the derivation twice in two languages would recreate it
one layer up. Neither implementation may carry a case this file does not.
pane: the agent_status herdr reports live, or null for a pane herdr has
never heard of, or "__down__" when herdr itself is unreachable.
done_event: whether the worktree's handoff bus carries a *_done event.

cases.name: stored blocked + pane idle + done event
cases.why: OBSERVED 2026-09-12: registry said blocked, pane was idle, work was finished. #59 clears blocked only when a prompt is ANSWERED, so a worker that goes quiet leaves the row forever.

cases.name: stored running + pane idle + done event
cases.why: OBSERVED 2026-09-12: registry said running for hours after the PR merged.

cases.name: pane idle + no done event
cases.why: OBSERVED 2026-09-12: #313's worker took a five-item review brief and went idle without touching the branch. Indistinguishable from working in every surface we had.

cases.name: pane done + no done event
cases.why: herdr's own 'done' means the agent stopped, not that the work landed.

cases.name: pane working + stored blocked
cases.why: live truth wins in both directions, not just the pessimistic one.

cases.name: pane working + no done event
cases.why: absence of a completion event is only meaningful once the worker has stopped.

cases.name: pane blocked + stored running
cases.why: a prompt on screen is a person's problem even when the registry missed it.

cases.name: stored completed survives a live pane
cases.why: acceptance is a fact herdr cannot know; a reused pane must not resurrect a closed task.

cases.name: stored failed survives a live pane
stored cancelled survives a live pane
stored lost survives a live pane
unknown pane
cases.why: herdr has no such pane: reconcile owns the verdict. Distinct from idle on purpose.

cases.name: herdr down + stored running
cases.why: a dead herdr must not silently mark the whole fleet stalled and page a human about it.

cases.name: done event OLDER than the last brief
cases.why: THE MASKING CASE. A worker that finished round one, was handed a review brief, and went quiet still carries round one's completion evidence. Judging evidence without comparing it to the last thing the worker was ASKED reports that worker completed — which is how PR #313's five dropped findings stayed invisible. Evidence older than the brief is evidence about a previous round.

cases.name: done event NEWER than the last brief
cases.why: the same worker after it actually does the round: evidence postdates the ask.

cases.name: unrecognised agent_status passes through
cases.why: REVIEW FINDING: the shell coerced an unknown status back to the STORED copy — the very thing this change stops trusting — while Python passed it through. Both suites passed because neither exercised it. A status we do not recognise is still herdr's answer, and inventing one is how the copies started.

cases.name: a pane list with no panes array is herdr not answering
cases.why: REVIEW FINDING: a partially-initialised or version-skewed server returns {"result":{}} with exit 0. The shell read that as 'this pane is absent' and derived `gone` for EVERY task — handing reconcile a fleet-wide verdict off a shape nothing verified. Unparseable is unreachable: fall back to stored.
